ns2:course.label: Legal Aspects of Sport
ns2:course.description: A study of legal principles and their impact on the sport industry; the course examines the application of different areas of law including tort, contract, constitutional, anti-trust, and intellectual property law to professional, amateur and recreational sport.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Recreation, Sport, and Tourism major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
